what_to_expect: Short days, cold water. Trout won't go far for a meal, so the fly has to go to them.
Longer days, warming water. The snow hasn't let go yet, and that won't last.
The snow's coming down. Freestones run high and dirty. Dam release rivers hold up better.
Rivers drop and clear. Heaviest hatches of the year. Hard to beat.
Low water, warm afternoons. Carry a thermometer and use it.
Water's cooling and brown trout have spawning on their minds. Nothing wrong with a big fly.
